study: native profiling and bounded Rust control paths
status: prospective operational correction after an unsuccessful sampling attempt; original protocol and partial results remain archived

recovery.reason: Transient workspace loss; reconstruct protocol and runners, then rerun all gates. No prior profiling measurements are claimed.

scope: Diagnostic native synthetic-fixture timing and Rust microbenchmarks, analyzed separately from Tika OCR quality and end-to-end service comparisons.

allocators.allocation_gates: System; process-local standalone executables, Rust allocator only; no zero-allocation claim for ONNX Runtime or OpenCV

resources.ownership: Each phase gets a fresh cgroup. OCR, perf, its shell and analysis tools share the stated total limit.
resources.page_cache: Identity verification and acquisition warm model file cache outside the measured cgroup. This is not cold storage startup. File-backed memory may remain charged to another cgroup; memory.peak is not an isolated cold-cache footprint.

ocr.warmup: all enabled sessions followed by one full selected-fixture request; allocate output and open stats file before enabling sampling
ocr.expected_output: all final text bytes must equal the existing frozen reference
ocr.latency_summary: successful warmed requests only; nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 per block and recorded/unrecorded median ratios; descriptive repeated-run quantities, no independent-sample or causal confidence interval

sampling.tool: host Linux perf; exact binary hash, package/version, kernel and access policies recorded
sampling.control: existing distinct FIFOs; initial sampling disabled; enable and disable require the exact five bytes ack newline NUL within five seconds, matching perf sizeof(EVLIST_CTL_CMD_ACK_TAG)
sampling.target: default workload mode with inherited thread events; no --cpu, --all-cpus or --per-thread selector. External cgroup quota and affinity still constrain the process and its threads.
sampling.sample_identity: All 64 request records identify one positive u32 process_id; every parsed sample header must contain that exact PID and a positive u32 TID. Unknown/missing/foreign headers, ambiguous loss counters, or mismatched folded counts fail.
sampling.region: warmed repeated OCR loop, including stats/control overhead; excludes startup, model verification, fixture warmup, final expected-output check and teardown
sampling.rejection: denied perf, nonzero command, incomplete ACK, absent/invalid counters, too few samples, loss, missing output or folded/sample mismatch fails and preserves raw evidence
sampling.interpretation: software CPU-time sampling; not IPC or hardware AVX counters, not proof of exhausted optimization options
sampling.whole_process_fallback: manual diagnostic only, labeled startup-inclusive and outside this controlled comparison; never silently substitute it

flamegraph.build: cargo install --locked --no-default-features --features cli; keep upstream Cargo.lock
flamegraph.visual_review: pending until full SVG and PNG are inspected after capture
flamegraph.symbols: unstripped Rust profiling binary with DWARF line tables; native archives may supply function symbols without C++ source lines

criterion.model_cache: verified cache of exactly the files in backend/models.lock.json, filesystem page cache warmed by prior acquisition and identity checks
criterion.telemetry_scope: fixed-array W3C trace parent parsing only; no exporter/network throughput claim

fixture_scope: Synthetic implementation fixtures, excluded from the frozen multilingual quality corpus and its English-admission counts.

distribution.artifact: complete diagnostic executable bundle and its native/Rust/glibc relink materials
distribution.binding: build identity records the OCR profiling binary hash; complete bundle manifest plus exact source/lock/build inputs preserved
